headline: Sensex surges 1,225 points as Indian markets extend rally for fourth straight day

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing macro pressures and declining crude oil prices supported investor sentiment.
Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows drove market buying.
Positive second-quarter earnings reports provided additional momentum.
Broad-based market buying lifted benchmark indices to record intraday highs.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 1,225 points to hit record intraday levels during Tuesday's session.
Nifty extended its winning streak for the fourth day, crossing the 23,800 mark.
State Bank of India reported a 14% increase in Q2 net profit with improved asset quality.
MCX registered a 10% profit growth while INOX India reported a 27% increase in Q2 revenue.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices surged sharply, with the Sensex gaining 1,225 points and Nifty crossing 23,800.
The four-day rally was backed by easing macro pressures, FII inflows, and lower oil prices.
Key corporate earnings highlights included strong Q2 performance from SBI, MCX, and INOX India.
